horizon: Local inventory plus selected remote/main and isolated repair worktrees. Uneven review depth is explicitly encoded; this is not a complete list of every estate repository or a TRG/CRG rating.

T.label: Tested slice
T.meaning: A relevant executable check passed in this audit. Read the note for the slice; not whole-system certification.

P.label: Proof checked
P.meaning: The actual proof tool checked the stated formal model. Runtime correspondence is a separate column.

I.label: Implementation inspected
I.meaning: A relevant implementation body was inspected. It was not necessarily built or executed.

D.label: Design specified
D.meaning: Reviewed design or contract; implementation is not established for this cell.

!.label: Partial / blocked
!.meaning: A specific gap, stub, failed check, or conditional guarantee was identified. See evidence.

F.label: Candidate file only
F.meaning: A related filename was enumerated. Its existence establishes neither implementation nor correctness.

?.label: Not assessed
?.meaning: No sufficient component assessment in this audit. This is not a claim of absence.

R.label: Related canonical core
R.meaning: Use the named canonical core; this face/dialect has no independently established guarantee here.

H.label: Host / different role
H.meaning: The row is a library/foundation/augmentation. The native-language component belongs to its host or is outside this role.

X.label: Private scope
X.meaning: Private implementation details are deliberately not included in the public atlas.
